promptTriggers.@establish: medium view of proud space princess, dusky-skin, brown eyes, false eyelashes wearing sheer purple headdress over ornate ornamental braids, aloof and glancing away, one hand on hip.
promptTriggers.@overhead: a wide view from above, the same woman walking seductively, head high, in the sheer headdress and long regal space gown.
promptTriggers.@closeup: extreme closeup face of the same woman, a bittersweet smile, and sensual eyes, eye contact.
promptTriggers.@behind: over the shoulder medium view of the same woman walking away, sheer purple headdress over ornate ornamental braids, upperback-half of regal gown.
promptTriggers.@coy: the same woman with sly expression, head-tilt and coy posture, side-glance, half-smile, ornate ornamental braids.
promptTriggers.@profile: profile of the same woman, determined eyes, mid-speech, sheer purple headdress over ornate ornamental braids.
